title: Shinonome Ena — Peaceful Moments, If Nothing Else〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <They should be meeting right about now...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Don't worry... Well, as much as I want to say that, we're talking about Yuki's mom here...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Haha. But there's no use in us worrying! I mean, we told her to let us know if anything does happen.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Also, we're here because we both know that. So, why don't we talk about something else?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
<Ah, I see.
Thank you for being friends with Mafuyu.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <Mafuyu mentioned a friend who plays music. Is that you?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What do you think they're talking about?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I mean...
They're probably arguing over whether or not Mafuyu should give up music, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <At the same time, it's pretty weird to have that sort of discussion without the person in question present...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I wouldn't worry. I'm sure Kanade will tell her exactly how Mafuyu feels...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'm not actually that worried about Kanade, but...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<If things don't go well...
I'm concerned that we won't be able to meet Mafuyu anymore.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Which is why I think I should go meet her alone...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <If she learns who you both are, Mafuyu may have no one else to turn to... She'd be all alone...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Do you really think she's just gonna roll over...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Isn't there anything we can do for Mafuyu...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <This probably won't solve anything, but I do have an idea...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Whoa, easy! Don't get your hopes up or anything...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But we could try letting her know that there's a place where she's always welcome.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Remember what you said, Ena?
Her expression clearly changes when she's working with us, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It's not just her... I feel so at home with N25 and it's been huge for me...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You're right. I agree with you completely, Mizuki...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <So, thanks. I feel a little better now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, let's do that. I want to have my illustration ready by the time Mafuyu comes back.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wait, even though your rough draft still isn't done?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Shut up. I can get it done if I buckle down and focus.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<So, let's get started.
Wanna just leave voice chat on?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Sure. Also, while we're on the subject... I'm still waiting on your rough draft. Oh where, oh where could it be...?>
